goal: Read actual verified published designer-author revision images, identify exact stage contrasts without inventing creator pen paths, and extract constrained decisions with reject/rollback conditions rather than repeat geometric ratios.
photo_rights: Use remote read-only checksum and aggregate metrics; do not copy source photos into public GitHub, training corpora, or commercially usable assets

stage_classification.observed: Historical grey glyph and traced-like pencil/brush first draft are followed by an expressive black finalized designer face; figure visually shows redesigned main stroke mass and terminals, not just texture.
stage_classification.forbidden: Do not assert recreated pen pressure, chronological edit list or quantitative improvement from unregistered staging panels.
stage_classification.decision_hypothesis: Construct a new style after drawing and assessing multiple exemplars, rather than copying source calligraphy contours unchanged.

stage_classification.observed: Author labels red contour BEFORE and blue contour AFTER; explicit figure caption: revision of proportion of 阝 primary radical in numerous structurally related characters.
stage_classification.supported_reason: The article explicitly describes component harmonization over many characters; author also states widening 口 initially did not generalize, requiring rollback to narrower width.
stage_classification.decision_hypothesis: Review every inherited component across family glyphs in context and rollback local attractive feature if family typography loses consistency.
stage_classification.metrics: Only compare isolated color glyph bounding-box size, normalized centroid and silhouette occupancy if enough red and blue pixels, otherwise leave 'measurement_inconclusive'. Overlays are not automatically a brush motion record.

stage_classification.observed: Same phrase labeled before and after; magnification identifies a local narrowed U-shaped negative space; print designed outline, not actual hand brush.
stage_classification.decision_hypothesis: In squeezed variants, reauthor counter shape where naive scaling makes the gap visually too tight; maintain glyph legibility.

stage_classification.observed: Standard and C80 narrowed variant compared; NO evidence that one is original draft and other is revision.
Interview publishes before/after letterform tweaks and first-person rationale around legibility, teaching, and consistent components.
stage_classification.author_direct_statement: When testers found a 木 stroke end unnatural, the team revised related glyph families rather than only that glyph; same components require appropriate consistency in connected/separate strokes.
stage_classification.decision_hypothesis: Real user observation can override studio assumptions, with consistency checked in all related radicals and words.

freeze_rules: No previous complete licensed font graphics copied into new wordmarks
First party before/after is credible as published stage illustration but not automatically genuine live software edit history
Before vs after glyphs in DIFFERENT scales are not directly pixel comparable
A visually similar correction is not an aesthetic causal proof
Every candidate operator must supply APPLY, REJECT and ROLLBACK conditions grounded in published designer commentary
R7-R9 geometry-only adjustment cannot be re-marketed as method learning
No new drawing or image generation until actual source evidence translated into verifiable and context-sensitive process
No new paid licenses, subscriptions or external API charges
next_gate: Verify bytes and red/cyan contours on same authored image; then mark source-grounded decision classes and only consider an unseen functional counterfactual. Artistic quality remains NOT VALIDATED.
